crossRefs.note: Now king David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.
Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king…

translations.web: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
translations.bsb: Again, if two lie down together, they will keep warm; but how can one keep warm alone?
translations.kjv: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm
translations.asv: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one be warm alone?
